calibration.coldDefinition: Local scan: fresh Node process/source handle, three runs; warm: same process, five runs. OS filesystem cache is uncontrolled. Database scan runs are repeated warm scans; no cold-disk claim.
limitations: SQL execution counts are logical database work, not physical TCP round trips.

resources.method: sampled working set/CPU of explicitly owned stable PIDs; excludes unobserved short-lived helpers

freeze.rssScope: zero-browser calibration: supervisor/server/PostgreSQL/current MCP stable PIDs; not combined three-browser RSS

cpuCeilingReference.measuredScope: sampled working set/CPU of explicitly owned stable PIDs; excludes unobserved short-lived helpers
cpuCeilingReference.scope: Exact matched zero-browser calibration workflow, normalized by completed reference/seed/source-scan/DB-scan bytes; 25% headroom. Not a whole final-matrix total or unobserved-helper CPU claim.

databaseStatementCeiling.scope: Exact matched zero-browser calibration workflow, normalized by completed HTTP reference/seed/DB-scan bytes; 10% headroom. Logical executions include background work, not physical TCP round trips.

freeze.pendingTransferRule: Finite target = 2 * (verified-prefix reference + bounded measured transfer reference for B-N pending bytes on actual wire profile) + 5000 ms; 1 GiB 40.513 s calibration applies to N=B=1 GiB, zero pending bytes only.

live.name: local

inferredHelperStarts.basis: verified classic artifact one-helper-per-successful-follower-HTTP mapping; changed artifacts and pre-network failures are unobserved

limitations: Three witnesses are correlated views of one source stream; browser count never multiplies independent samples.
Visible high water represents coalesced committed progress; intermediate sequences may be superseded.

independentLatency.scope: unique canonical commit/outbox/revision-changing raster cohorts; correlated source markers and three views never multiply independent counts
